name: Insecure HTTP URL
messageTemplate: Insecure HTTP URL detected. Prefer HTTPS endpoints.
description: Detects usage of plain HTTP URLs (not localhost) which transmit data unencrypted.

name: Insecure WebSocket
messageTemplate: WebSocket uses ws://. Prefer wss:// for TLS.
description: Detects usage of ws:// WebSocket connections instead of secure wss://.

name: Insecure gRPC Credentials
messageTemplate: gRPC channel uses insecure credentials (no TLS).
description: Detects ChannelCredentials.insecure() usage in gRPC which disables TLS.

name: HttpOverrides.global
messageTemplate: HttpOverrides.global used: overrides network behavior globally.
description: Detects global HTTP override which can bypass security checks application-wide.

name: Insecure TLS Callback
messageTemplate: badCertificateCallback used. This disables certificate validation.
description: Detects badCertificateCallback usage which can disable TLS certificate validation.

name: Disabled Certificate Validation
messageTemplate: validateCertificate set to false: TLS certificate validation disabled.
description: Detects validateCertificate being set to false which disables cert checks.

name: Weak Hash MD5
messageTemplate: Use of MD5 hash detected. Prefer SHA-256 or stronger.
description: MD5 is cryptographically broken and should not be used for security purposes.

name: Weak Hash SHA-1
messageTemplate: Use of SHA-1 hash detected. Prefer SHA-256 or stronger.
description: SHA-1 has known collision vulnerabilities and should not be used for security.

name: Dio onHttpClientCreate
messageTemplate: onHttpClientCreate callback may bypass TLS checks in Dio.
description: Dio's onHttpClientCreate can be used to disable certificate validation.

name: HttpClient Usage
messageTemplate: HttpClient detected. Ensure secure TLS configuration.
description: Direct HttpClient usage requires manual TLS configuration which is often insecure.
